name: eth-stalking
description: ETH STALKING — USDT deposit verification, internal ledger, admin-managed staking records and rewards (local development build)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/server
scripts.start: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
